title: Investment memo + red-team panel
description: Preserve bull, bear, and base positions and route unsupported consensus to accountable review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: investment-memo-red-team-panel
  title: Investment memo + red-team panel
  description: Preserve bull, bear, and base positions and route unsupported consensus to accountable review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Preserve bull, bear, and base positions and route unsupported consensus to accountable review.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Equity Research Analyst
      templateRef: fin-01
      role: Equity Research Analyst operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Build a source-grounded investment view that separates reported facts, estimates, assumptions, and
        valuation implications.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Bull-Case Advocate
      templateRef: fin-02
      role: Bull-Case Advocate operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Construct the strongest evidence-supported upside case and state the milestones required for it to
        hold.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Bear-Case Advocate
      templateRef: fin-03
      role: Bear-Case Advocate operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Construct the strongest evidence-supported downside case and identify permanent-loss mechanisms.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Preserve positions and ties
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: decision
      kind: condition
      name: Decision supported?
      config:
        expression: vote.has_supported_position
        branches:
          - label: Supported
            when: supported
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: combine
      to: decision
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: decision
      to: approval
      kind: control
      condition: supported
    - id: e9
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
